page_description: Manage your learner profile and account settings
profile_description: Update your learner name and email address
resend_verification: Click here to resend the verification email.
verification_sent: A new verification link has been sent to your email address.
password_description: Ensure your account is using a long, random password to stay secure
google_account_password_hint: If your account was registered with Google, you can leave current password empty and set a new password directly.
delete_account_description: Delete your account and all of its resources
delete_warning_description: Please proceed with caution, this cannot be undone.
delete_modal_title: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
delete_modal_description: Once your account is deleted, all of its resources and data will also be permanently deleted. Please enter your password to confirm you would like to permanently delete your account.
teacher_cert_description: Review and accept teacher responsibilities and learning-resource publishing guidelines before submitting your application.
teacher_cert_already_teacher: Your account has been verified as a teacher.
teacher_cert_pending_desc: Your application has been submitted and is awaiting admin review. We will notify you once a decision has been made.
teacher_cert_approved_desc: Congratulations! Your teacher certification has been verified.
teacher_cert_upload_hint: Optionally upload certificates, proof of qualification, or other teaching credentials. Supported: PDF, images, Word documents. Max 5 files, 10 MB each.
teacher_cert_rules_description: I confirm that I will follow platform teaching policies, provide truthful credentials, and accept review decisions by the admin team.
teacher_cert_rules_agree: I have read and agree to the teacher application rules.
teacher_cert_drag_subtitle: or click "Add Documents" to browse files
teacher_cert_supported_format: PDF · JPG · PNG · DOC · DOCX · Max 10 MB each
teacher_cert_file_too_large: One or more files exceed the 10 MB limit.
teacher_cert_max_files: You can upload a maximum of 5 documents.
teacher_cert_no_preview: This file type cannot be previewed in the browser.
